summary: Saved dashboard variable with regex capture truncates trace link anchor and causes 500 on trace lookup
description:
Issue summary: Customers that save dashboard variables using a regex capture group (e.g. /service-(.*)/) observe that trace links generated by the dashboard truncate the 'span_anchor' query parameter. When users click the trace link, the trace service returns a 500 and the console shows 'Trace lookup failed: invalid anchor'.

Impact: Aurora Health reported multiple users unable to jump from dashboard panels to corresponding traces for ~18 panels across several org projects. This blocks debugging of production LLM latency spikes for the customer and prevents normal incident triage. Approx 8% of dashboard-to-trace clicks from the affected org returned 500s over the last 24h.

Environment: prod (us-east), console v3.12.4 edge, tracing-service v2.7.1, query-engine v5.3.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Create a saved dashboard variable with 'Regex (capture)' type and pattern: /svc-(.*)/
2) Use that variable in panel queries and enable trace links (panel -> Trace ID link).
3) Save dashboard and click the generated trace link for a panel row where variable resolved to 'svc-payments-123'.
4) Observe redirect to /traces?trace_id=...&span_anchor=svc-payments-123 but the span_anchor value appears truncated on the trace service side and a 500 is returned.

Expected behavior: Trace links should include the full expanded variable value for span_anchor and redirect to the trace viewer without error.

Actual behavior: span_anchor is truncated at first hyphen when variable was produced via regex capture (e.g. 'svc-payments-123' becomes 'svc'). Trace service raises a 500: "invalid anchor format".

Logs/observations: Frontend console shows URL encoded parameter span_anchor=svc%2Dpayments%2D123 but tracer-api logs show incoming span_anchor=svc. Backend query-engine appears to be doing an extra tokenization step when variable origin is flagged as 'regex-capture'. No errors appear in console logs when variable comes from a plain text variable.

Temporary workaround: 1) Edit dashboard variable to be 'Text list' instead of regex capture, or 2) modify regex to include entire string in a single capture group without hyphens (not practical for many customers). Support can advise Aurora Health to change variable type as a stopgap.

Customer impact and urgency: Enterprise customer, active incidents in their product team. Customer requested elevated support and requested a Hotfix or rollback.
comments: 2026-03-12 09:22 - Evan McClain (Support): Customer reported: 'After saving a regex variable our trace links break. Help!'. Initial triage indicates pattern with capture groups correlates with failing trace lookups.

2026-03-12 10:05 - Mateo Chen (SRE): Reproduced locally on prod-like stack. When variable_origin == 'regex_capture' our query serializer calls tokenize_var_parts() which strips on '-' delimiter. Adding as internal ticket INT-4412 for engineer investigation.
2026-03-12 13:40 - Aurora Health (Customer): Thanks — this is blocking our SRE team from investigating latency spikes. Can you provide ETA for a fix?

2026-03-13 08:15 - Lena Novak (Frontend): Confirmed frontend sends URL-encoded full string. Backend is receiving truncated piece. Posting logs and correlating tracer-api and query-engine traces to INT-4412. Potential suspect: variable normalization layer introduced in 3.12.3.
2026-03-13 16:27 - Mateo Chen (SRE): Drafted a minimal patch to disable tokenize_var_parts for regex_capture origin. Will prepare a hotfix candidate and smoke test in staging.

2026-03-14 07:58 - Evan McClain (Support): Notified customer we will attempt hotfix deployment to staging today and provide ETA for production. Customer requested targeted deploy to their org only if possible.

2026-03-14 11:02 - Mateo Chen (SRE): Hotfix PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/5891 — disabling token-splitting path for regex-captured variables. Running integration tests and trace-link e2e.
investigation_notes:
2026-03-12 10:12 - Repro: Created dashboard variable /svc-(.*)/; panel link built as expected in frontend; service request to tracer-api shows span_anchor=svc.
Hypothesis: query-engine normalization is applying a split on '-' to all variables originating from regex captures for historical reasons (legacy tokenization for older dashboards).

2026-03-12 11:00 - Review of commits: Identify commit 3b9f7a2 (console: variable-normalize) introduced change in v3.12.3. That commit added tokenize_var_parts() and marked regex-capture origin for special handling.
Potential regression window: v3.12.3 -> v3.12.4.

2026-03-13 09:30 - Tracing-service logs: 8 trace lookup 500s between 2026-03-11 22:00 and 2026-03-12 05:00 for org_id=aurora-health. Error: 'invalid anchor format: expected spanId:offset'.
Correlated to dashboard trace links where span_anchor lacked expected colon separator.

2026-03-13 15:45 - Local fix test: Patch to skip tokenize_var_parts for regex_capture removes truncation and returns full span_anchor to tracer-api. E2E verifies trace viewer navigates to correct span. No other panels appear affected in smoke tests.

2026-03-14 10:50 - Risk assessment: Change affects variable normalization path. Regression risk low if we gate change to only bypass tokenize_var_parts when variable_origin == 'regex_capture'. Recommend hotfix release to prod with canary to 5% orgs then 100%.
Artifacts: link to staging run showing successful trace navigation: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/console-e2e/5891
resolution: Hotfix PR merged to main and deployed to prod canary (5% of orgs) on 2026-03-14 14:20 UTC. Observed successful trace navigation for Aurora Health in canary. Full rollout scheduled 2026-03-14 18:00 UTC pending monitoring. Root cause: variable normalization path tokenized regex-capture variables on hyphens; hotfix bypasses tokenization for regex-capture origin.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-14 14:45 - Deployed to canary: No additional 500s observed for canary orgs in 30m window.
2026-03-14 17:55 - Full rollout completed: console v3.12.5. Noted a ~0.2% increase in trace lookup latency during rollout (expected, transient).
2026-03-14 18:10 - Notified Aurora Health and support contact provided post-deploy verification steps. Customer confirmed trace links working for previously failing panels.
follow_up_items: Add regression test covering dashboard variables with regex capture and trace link generation (assigned to frontend team).
Audit variable-normalization logic to ensure no other special-cases cause parameter mutation (assigned INT-4412).
Add monitoring alert for anomalous spike in tracer-api 500s filtered by referrer header 'console-panel' (SRE).
Document workaround and update KB article: 'Dashboard variables and trace links' in Support Docs.
